title: ochna humilis
intro: Ochna humilis, commonly known as Mickey Mouse plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ochnaceae. This plant is traditionally used in African medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ochna humilis include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
